description: This Java class models the product pricing entity in an e-commerce application, including price details, special pricing, descriptions, and related availability. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing product pricing details, including base price, special price, descriptions, and associated product availability, mapped to the PRODUCT_PRICE table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product price entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product price entity.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date for the special price period.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the special price period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date for the special price period.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the special price period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special price amount, if any.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions related to this product price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions related to this product price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Indicates whether this is the default price for the product.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets the default price indicator.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Returns the availability information for the associated product.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Sets the availability associated with this price.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifying this price.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifying this price.

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the type of this product price (e.g., one-time).

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the product price.
